test_title: PYST 49: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. Select the option 'no correction required' if the sentence is correct as given.

We saw him (the more) during Hogsmeade weekend.
solution:
The correct answer is "**the most**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error is in the use of the word 'more.'
 
• **The sentence is comparing the frequency of seeing "him" during Hogsmeade weekend to some previous time.**
 
• **The correct comparative form of "more" in this case is "most".**
 
• The quantifier "most" is used to talk about quantities, amounts and degree.
 
• "Bigger" (option 1) and "many" (option 3) do not make sense in this context.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
